item.title: Tata Punch EV Facelift Price, Specifications and Features
item.description: Tata Motors has launched the Punch EV facelift in India, starting at INR 969,000. It features a new 40kWh battery with a 468km ARAI-certified range and supports 65kW fast charging. Key upgrades include a redesigned fascia, ventilated seats, and six standard airbags, alongside a lifetime battery warranty for the first owner.

item.title: Has Israel Found a Cure for Cancer and Successfully Treated Benjamin Netanyahu’s Blood Cancer? Here’s the Fact Check
item.description: Viral claims from the parody account HFR Podcast alleging Israel discovered a "cancer cure" to treat Prime Minister Netanyahu’s "blood cancer" are false. A February 2026 medical report from the PMO confirms Netanyahu is cancer-free; his recent surgery involved a benign prostate growth. Israel’s research continues, but no universal cure exists.
